title: Alphaastro's Miner's Dream
description: Just another orespawn miner's dream mod.
body: Miner's Dream is a one-use explosive item that instantly carves a massive tunnel in the direction you're facing. It preserves all ores even modded ones and valuables, places torches automatically every 5 blocks on both walls, and only destroys common blocks like stone, dirt, and sand.It is crafted from 3 of each of cactus, redstone block , and gunpowder, as shown in the gallery.
